authorization: Independent RAW comparison entry; does not enable or resume the historical Grid-only campaign
information_isolation: Only own chronological configuration, classification and score observations are supplied to each strategy. Grid, validation, retest and other trajectory data are never supplied.
retests: Deduplicate selected prefix candidates within each algorithm only; independent fresh groups after its 12-observation trajectory; no feedback; do not share groups across algorithms

admission.criteria_source: Unchanged raw_formal_timing_protocol.json admission; all conservative RAW ranges required

continuity.sleep_request: ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED on Windows controller thread; verify nonzero result, release ES_CONTINUOUS in finally; cannot prevent user closing lid
continuity.event_log: System RecordId cursor, Kernel-Power 42/506 standby and 107/507 wake, Power-Troubleshooter 1; save messages and XML
continuity.standby_action: Preserve all samples/cost; mark disturbed; no comparable completion; stop without retry
continuity.comparison: abs(host QPC evaluation envelope - guest RAW evaluation interval) <= max(30, 0.05 * guest RAW evaluation interval)
continuity.scope: Host brackets the RUN request and FINISHED response after READY; guest RAW brackets only ConfigurationEvaluator.evaluate. Transport is included in host envelope; WSL startup, setup, source checks, resource gate and boundary probes are excluded from both. No subtraction of guessed overhead or calibration.

budget.claim: Exclusive, one activity window per session; repeated invocation cannot reset or re-claim budget
budget.included: From before admission resource gate through admission, setup verification, all gates, target groups, boundary checks and cleanup; nested RAW costs are reported separately, not added

failure_policy: Stop on any identity, gate, clock, correctness, continuity, budget or execution failure; keep partial groups; no automatic retry, replacement, filtering or performance-cache reuse
